content:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — proposing a 'Coalition handshake' for SI lead claims to cut down double-claims. Short summary below, pls react :eyes:
Maria Gonzales: Sounds good. Paste the rules here?
Alex Kim: Rules draft:
1) SI claim = set `SI_Claim__c` in SFDC (owner + timestamp)
2) 24h hot-claim window after intake to let the SI validate
3) >$50k ARR opportunities require AO review before final claim
4) If SI brings a hardware partner, enable 'tri-party' flow and tag `HW_Partner__c`
5) Conflicts escalate to partnerships@redwood.com within 48h
6) Co-sell credit split default 60/40 unless sales leadership overrides
Jon Patel: +1. For (3) suggest threshold and a quick ops approval form. who owns the mapping matrix?
Priya Rao: I'll add region ownership. I'll take EMEA + APAC mapping. Jon, can you do NA + LATAM?
Jon Patel: Yep, NA + LATAM on me. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Maria Gonzales: For the matrix, SalesOps should be source-of-truth. Jon — can you loop them in?
Jon Patel: Looping SalesOps now. @SalesOps — please own `SI_Matrix` in SFDC and keep it updated.
partners-bot: Playbook created: /playbooks/si-coalition-handshake (confluence) — https://redwood.atl/confluence/si-coalition-handshake
Alex Kim: Intake form changes (snippet):
```
fields:
  - SI_Claim__c (checkbox)
  - HW_Partner__c (picklist)
  - Tech_Validated__c (checkbox)
  - Opportunity_ARR__c (number)
```
Priya Rao: We'll add `Tech_Validated` step requiring eng-platform signoff for any tri-party.
Sam Lee: For announcements: no public joint announcement until AO + Legal signoff. Proposed timeline: draft -> partner review (3 business days) -> legal (3 bd) -> marketing prep (2 bd).
Maria Gonzales: Can we automate notifications to #marketing when AO flag is set?
Alex Kim: Yes, we'll add a webhook from SalesOps: when AO_Approved__c = true post to #marketing and create GH ticket for comms.
Jon Patel: One other case — if SI claims but then stalls for >30 days, claim should be released back to intake queue.
Priya Rao: Agreed. Auto-release rule: 30 days no-op -> notify SI -> 7 days final -> release.
Maria Gonzales: This looks actionable. I'll draft the one-pager and circulate for sign-off.
Alex Kim: Thanks — please react with :thumbsup: when you've reviewed. I'll follow up with a short stakeholder meeting invite.
Sam Lee: +1 :rocket:
